build_plot_circos_heatmap: build a circos heatmap plot from 1d or 2d numeric data with configurable colormap and value display
create_plot_stacked_bar_chart: create a stacked bar chart from table data with configurable column colors and row labels
create_plot_genomic_features: create a circos plot of genomic features from Biopython SeqFeature objects in box or arrow style
create_plot_phylogenetic_tree: create a phylogenetic tree visualization on a circos track from newick or phyloxml formatted tree data
test_plot_circos_bars: test plotting circular bar charts on a track with configurable width, alignment, and bottom offsets
